Maria (devex): Quick sync — shipping window is next Tue 09:00 PT. Changelog cutoff = this Fri EOD. posting checklist and who can own what?
Sam P: I can take the Python SDK PRs (GH: #2481, #2490). Will open a follow-up for the docstring nit fixes.
Priyanka: I can own the Quickstarts/README pass. Will run the smoke locally tomorrow.
Kev: I’ll handle sample app CI flakes — seeing failures on sampleapp-e2e related to auth mock.
Jess: Docs pass? I can do the API reference and quickstart guide — pinging @Maria for changelog entries.
Maria (devex): Awesome. Need one more owner for Node SDK. @Ben?
Ben: Yep I’ll take Node SDK and the changelog section for SDKs.
Priyanka: Heads up — one quickstart depends on a new env var behavior in runtime; if that lands late we may need a patch sample.
Kev: That env var change is landing in runtime today (PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/562). If it goes green I’ll update the sampleapp in the same PR.
Sam P: Question on changelog formatting — do we use the short bullet list or the expanded entry per SDK?
Maria (devex): Use short bullets under categories: "SDKs", "Quickstarts", "Sample apps", "Docs". Keep entries 1-2 lines. I pasted template below.
Maria (devex): ```
- SDKs: Python v1.4.2 (minor fixes), Node v2.0.0-rc (breaking auth change)
- Quickstarts: Updated README for runtime env var, added local smoke script
- Sample apps: samplebook: auth mock + e2e stability fixes
- Docs: API reference updates, new troubleshooting section for auth
```
Jess: Can we include an example command for the local smoke script? I’ll add a small snippet to the Docs PR.
Priyanka: I’ll update the quickstart readme with the exact command once Kev confirms the runtime PR merge.
Kev: Runtime CI flaky but rerunning now. release-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for runtime/pr/562 (status: running).
Ben: If runtime PR slips past Fri EOD cutoff, do we cut changelog without the quickstart note and ship a follow-up patch?
Maria (devex): Yes — prefer to ship on time and follow up. Only exception is a release-blocking regression.
Sam P: I have one failing test in python-sdk CI that looks like a timeout in the generator tests — will debug tonight.
Jess: Estimated PRs: docs/PR #402, quickstarts/PR #110, node-sdk/PR #305, python-sdk/PR #770, sampleapp/PR #88. Can owners call for reviews by Mon EOD?
Ben: Affirmative — I’ll ping eng-releases and assign reviewers.
Priyanka: I’ll also add a note in the changelog draft that quickstart will be updated post-merge if needed.
Kev: runtime PR is green now. I pushed sampleapp fixes in sampleapp/PR #88. CI passing locally, kicking cloud runs.
release-bot: runtime/pr/562 -> merged by Kev at 4087654350
Sam P: Python CI fix merged (python-sdk/PR #770) at 4087654365 — rerunning integration tests.
Maria (devex): Great progress. Quick checklist: 1) Owners assigned (Python: Sam, Node: Ben, Quickstarts: Priyanka, Docs: Jess, Sampleapp CI: Kev). 2) Changelog draft = Maria (edit) + owners add bullets. 3) Reviews by Mon EOD. 4) Cut on Tue if all green.
Jess: I’ll start the Docs PR now and tag @Priyanka for quickstart copy review.
Ben: Tagging eng-platform for visibility on the auth change: @eng-platform-team please note runtime auth change may affect infra mocks.
Kev: Noted. If infra tests fail I’ll coordinate a hotfix branch for sampleapp.
Sam P: One more ask — can someone confirm the release notes pipeline picks up entries from CHANGELOG/drafts/*.md?
Maria (devex): Yes, release script scans CHANGELOG/drafts. Put your bullets in drafts/<date>-devexp.md. I’ll merge the draft on Tue morning.
Priyanka: Putting draft in CHANGELOG/drafts/2026-03-19-devexp.md now.
Jess: Docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/402 — adding changelog bullet and example command.
Ben: Node PR ready for review: https://github.com/redwood/node-sdk/pull/305 (tagging reviewers).
Kev: cloud CI passed for sampleapp/PR #88 at 4087654390.
Maria (devex): Closing loop — if anything blocks cutting the changelog ping this thread. Otherwise we’ll proceed with Tue ship. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Ben: :thumbsup:
Sam P: :raised_hands:
Priyanka: Will monitor quickstart smoke tomorrow morning.
